spans.text: Yokai are a type of fiend found within Somnus Domina, which are bound to the Realm of Shadow (in the same sense that devils are bound to the Hells, and demons to the Abyss). They are a unique form of fiendish life that only came to exist after the eidomantic web came into existence, and if the web were to fall into greater disarray the yokai’s numbers would swell. To prevent this, Vestias is constantly patching and repairing imperfections in the web to reduce their numbers. Thanks to this causal relationship, yokai are thought of by the gods as glitches in the fabric of modern magic.

Yokai come to be when curses, grudges, negativity, and other dark emotions overtake mortals, or when great tragedies befall them. Their twisted feelings are caught in the eidomantic web and given shape until they become knots in the web - only to then be ejected from it into the Realm of Shadows, where their fiendish essence becomes rooted. Basic yokai are intelligent, but often bestial and feral. They feed on the same emotions and tragedy that created them, so they seek to create more of it. Sometimes this means they must hunt mortals, and in other cases they manipulate them.

Yokai are born more prominently from those who have strong spiritual beliefs, and find it easier to appear in places that have weaker planar boundaries. Thanks to this, they are much more common in Cu Chullis than in Retia. This doesn’t mean they are absent in Retia, however. Yokai appear from the shadows, ready to antagonize and hunt mortals to make them miserable. They are often born from joint cultural feelings, such as from the rage of the oppressed or the despair of those killed unjustly. In particular, many yokai were born during the tragedy of the Palvarian Accords.

Daiyokai are known more commonly as yokai lords, and serve as the equivalent to archfiends and archdevils. They hold an innate control over other yokai like them, and typically control a great deal of territory within the Realm of Shadow. They come to be when a yokai has persisted so long and consumed enough that it evolves beyond its peers, or when an event creates such overwhelming negativity that a unique yokai is created unlike others seen before them.

Among yokai, daiyokai are treated like gods (and in many cases they might as well be); lesser yokai serve them instinctually. Thanks to their overwhelming power they typically have moved beyond hunting mere mortals, and take more devious approaches to sustaining themselves. Daiyokai are almost all capable of assuming a humanoid form, and blending in with mankind is a common strategy to inflict great suffering.

Yokai lords consider themselves above the brutality of demons and the pompous schemes of devils. They are emotional beings that manipulate the nature of others, not requiring their souls - only their despair. At their most successful they are masterful social puppets who can bend entire communities or kingdoms to their will.
